typography._note: Same finding as overview.json: the mockup face is narrower than Montserrat at equal cap/x-height (needs -0.03…-0.075em to match ink width at the cap-fitted size; the left-panel paragraph is the exception and fits at 0em). Here sizes are fitted to cap height (stem ends, blur-unbiased; x-height agrees within ~2%) and rounded to 0.5px; weights to stroke ink (blur-aware template fit against headless-Chrome Montserrat renders, gain≈1 for white text); 'tracking' fields are the WIDTH-EXACT values. Every text element's notes list the width at 0em and at the overview convention -0.03em so the implementer can harmonise with overview.json (which clamps at -0.03em). Ascenders/descenders in the mockup are 3–6% shorter than Montserrat's, so ink heights of b/d/l/g/p/y will exceed the mockup slightly. Every small white text carries ~6–10% more ink than a Chrome Montserrat render at the chosen weight (renderer difference), so grey/red text colours are INK-MATCHED (integrated ink of a render vs the mockup, with that surplus removed) rather than brightest-pixel values, which under-read thin strokes.
